name: TypeSafe AI (Jev System One)
description: Sub-100ms typed System One decision engine for OpenClaw: group chat triage, tool safety guardrails, compaction curation, and model routing.

apiKey.label: TypeSafe AI API Key
apiKey.help: API key from typesafe.ai for accessing the Jev model.

timeoutMs.label: Timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.help: Maximum milliseconds to wait for a Jev decision before falling back to heuristics (default: 250ms).

features.groupChatTriage.label: Group Chat Chatter Triage
features.groupChatTriage.help: Use Jev Noul to evaluate whether group chat messages need the assistant, suppressing casual chatter without agent invocations.

features.toolSafetyGate.label: Tool Safety Guardrails
features.toolSafetyGate.help: Use Jev Score to grade tool execution blast radius (1-5) and prompt for operator approval on critical operations.

features.compactionCuration.label: Pre-Compaction Tool Log Pruning
features.compactionCuration.help: Use Jev Choice to prune ephemeral, high-volume tool execution dumps before sending transcripts to the LLM summarizer, reducing compaction cost and latency.

features.compactionFidelityAudit.label: Compaction Fidelity Auditing
features.compactionFidelityAudit.help: Audit post-compaction session generation to track compaction metrics and prevent dropped task states.

features.modelComplexityRouting.label: Adaptive Model Complexity Routing
features.modelComplexityRouting.help: Use Jev Choice to classify prompt complexity and route between light utility models and frontier models.

features.promptInjectionAudit.label: Prompt Injection Screening
features.promptInjectionAudit.help: Score untrusted external web/email content for prompt injection before feeding it to the agent.

timeoutMs.description: Hard timeout in milliseconds before falling back

triageThreshold.description: Confidence threshold (0.0 - 1.0) required to suppress group chatter

safetyApprovalLevel.description: Risk score level (1 - 5) at or above which interactive approval is required

toolSafetyGate.description: Enable tool execution blast radius scoring

modelComplexityRouting.description: Enable adaptive model routing between utility and frontier tiers

promptInjectionAudit.description: Enable prompt injection screening on external content
